name: Doncaster

neighbourhoods.name: Hyde Park and town centre
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian terraces and flats over shops close to the centre, with a high share of private lets.

neighbourhoods.name: Balby
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian and Edwardian terraces near the centre and inter-war semis further out.

neighbourhoods.name: Wheatley and Intake
neighbourhoods.housing: Inter-war and post-war semis and council-built estates.

neighbourhoods.name: Bessacarr
neighbourhoods.housing: Mostly larger semis and detached houses from the inter-war years onwards.

neighbourhoods.name: Bentley
neighbourhoods.housing: Terraces and estates built for the colliery, now mostly mixed private and social housing.

neighbourhoods.name: Mexborough
neighbourhoods.housing: Terraced streets and post-war estates in a former mining and railway town.

neighbourhoods.name: Thorne
neighbourhoods.housing: A market town of older brick terraces and newer estates near the Humberhead peatlands.

neighbourhoods.name: Armthorpe
neighbourhoods.housing: A former pit village with colliery terraces and large modern estates.

neighbourhoods.name: Edlington
neighbourhoods.housing: Former colliery village housing, much of it terraced.

housing: Doncaster has a large stock of Victorian terraces near the town centre and many former colliery villages with pit terraces and council-built estates, where private renting has grown as homes have been sold on. Bessacarr and the southern suburbs have larger inter-war and post-war homes. Low-lying areas along the River Don, including Bentley and the north and east of the borough, flooded in 2007 and 2019.
checkinTips: Colliery terraces in former pit villages: photograph back yards, rear walls and any cracking that could be from settlement.
Homes in low-lying areas near the Don and Ea Beck: note flood-protection products and photograph tide marks or damp on low walls.
Victorian terraces near the town centre: photograph cellars, chimney breasts and window frames for damp and rot.
Flats over shops in the town centre: photograph the street door, stairs, smoke alarms and any shared meter cupboard.
Post-war estate homes: photograph fences, sheds and garden condition, which are often disputed at check-out.
tenantHelp: Private tenants with disrepair or unsafe conditions can contact City of Doncaster Council's private sector housing team.
